LESSON: MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Musical Instruments

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Musical Instruments, part of Strand 1 in Grade 3 MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.
